summary: Two relaxed days in Kandy, Sri Lanka's cultural capital and a UNESCO World Heritage city: the lake, a Kandyan dance show and the Temple of the Tooth on day one, then the temple museums and the botanical gardens at Peradeniya on day two.

day_plans.theme: Arrival, the lake and the Temple of the Tooth

activities.name: Kandy Lake
activities.description: Stretch your legs after the drive with a gentle walk around the lake in the centre of town.

activities.name: Kandyan dancing
activities.description: Watch a traditional Kandyan dance performance at the Kandy Cultural Centre near the lake.

activities.name: Temple of the Tooth (Sri Dalada Maligawa)
activities.description: Visit one of Sri Lanka's most sacred Buddhist shrines, home to a tooth relic of the Buddha, and see the relic's casket at the evening ceremony.

day_plans.theme: Temple museums and the botanical gardens

activities.name: Royal Palace of Kandy
activities.description: Explore the former royal palace beside the temple, which now houses an archaeological museum.

activities.name: World Buddhist Museum
activities.description: See how Buddhism is practised around the world at this museum in the temple complex.

activities.name: Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens
activities.description: Spend a relaxed afternoon in the botanical gardens at Peradeniya, a short drive from Kandy.

costs.quantity_note: One show; the upper end of the 2024 range of Rs 2,000-3,500.

costs.item: Second-class train ticket, Colombo to Kandy (one way)

facts.text: Intercity express trains from Colombo take 2.5 to 3 hours, with about 10 trains a day.
facts.quote: Intercity express trains are hassle-free and scenic, 2½-3 hours, 10 trains per day.

facts.text: Temple of the Tooth entry was Rs 2,000 for foreigners and Rs 500 for South Asian passport holders (a 2017 price; check the current fee).
facts.quote: Rs 2,000 (since Jan 2017) for foreigners and Rs 500 for South Asian passport holders.

facts.text: The relic's casket is shown twice a day; the evening showing is around 6:30 PM.
facts.quote: the second which could be the best time to view this ornate casket is around 6:30PM

facts.text: Entry to the Royal Palace and the World Buddhist Museum is included in the Temple of the Tooth ticket.
facts.quote: Entrance fee included into Temple of the Tooth ticket.

facts.text: Kandyan dance shows cost about Rs 2,000-3,500 a ticket (2024) and last about an hour.
facts.quote: As of 2024, expect prices to range from 2000 to 3500 per ticket for about 1 hour performances

facts.text: Agree the tuk-tuk fare before you ride; around Rs 60-70 a kilometre is a fair price.
facts.quote: If you can get them for Rs 60-70 per Km you are doing well

tips: Dress modestly for the temple: cover your shoulders and knees, and take off shoes and hats before you enter.
assumptions: You travel between places by car; the train is an alternative for the first day.
